tasks.short: Discuss progress and resource priorities with families

steps.what: Find and check this pupil's existing progress and support records in the school pupil system
inputs: Existing teacher-entered pupil progress and support records

steps.what: Discuss the child's progress, hear the family's account and agree priorities and resource needs
outputs: Agreed priorities and unresolved resource questions

steps.what: Write and check the required meeting record using the pupil-linked form and actual agreed priorities
Save the final meeting record in the same pupil system

tasks.design: Configure a pupil-specific progress view in {OPS_SYSTEM} and a linked meeting form. The teacher conducts the discussion and writes and checks the actual agreements before saving them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress records and the required meeting form may require repeated navigation and pupil identification.
tasks.enabler_now: The school's existing record system may support saved views and pupil-linked forms.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling family and school perspectives and securing suitable resources.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows the pupil and can negotiate realistic priorities with the family.

ambition.what: Improve preparation and recording without shortening the family discussion.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; school record owner checks family-data access and retention

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pupil record systems can provide filtered progress views and linked record forms.

assumptions: This episode includes an existing required meeting record, not an extra report invented after every conversation.
Teachers already enter progress records; s1 checks their currency and gaps, and s3 captures new agreements manually.
Use existing pupil-system functions first; unsupported views retain manual retrieval.
Illustrative active-effort split, not a measured baseline: gross saving 9.8 per 100 task hours; new upkeep 1.5; net 8.3. Saving the same-system record earns no gain.
unknowns: Actual retrieval effort and whether the school requires a meeting record for this episode
research_questions: Can the current pupil system show progress and support records together with existing permissions?

already_counted.description: Checking source records and writing and checking actual agreements

incremental.description: Maintain progress-view fields and meeting form

approvals.approved_version: Final meeting record checked in s3; any edit requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured scenario; only reduced navigation and repeated form entry, net of upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply school rules in actual pupil situations

steps.what: Find the applicable current school rule in the school's controlled policy library
outputs: Applicable rule and limits of teacher authority

steps.what: Enforce administration policies and rules governing students: observe the situation, hear the pupil, decide the appropriate response and apply the rule in person
outputs: Rule applied or matter escalated through the existing school process

steps.what: For this recordable incident, enter and check observed facts and the actual response in the pupil-linked incident form
Save the final incident record in the same pupil system

tasks.design: Use the current controlled policy index in {DOCS} and a pupil-linked incident form in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The teacher interprets and applies the rule, then writes and checks the actual incident record where the school already requires one.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current rule and repeatedly selecting pupil and incident fields can interrupt handling a situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document search and record forms can reduce navigation without inferring misconduct.
tasks.still_hard: Proportionate treatment, context, safeguarding concerns and disputed accounts.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher can assess the actual situation and respond appropriately to the pupil.

ambition.what: Reduce lookup and required recording effort within current authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; school policy and pupil-record owners check access and incident fields

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document search and pupil-linked forms can assist rule lookup and incident recording.

assumptions: This illustrative episode concerns an incident for which recording is already required; routine verbal reminders do not acquire a new record.
The teacher supplies actual observations and response in s3; no sensor feed or inferred behaviour labels are assumed.
No automated sanction, guardian notification or formal order is proposed; any such action needs its own final-version gate and existing authority.
Illustrative gross saving 8.3 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1.5, net 6.8; same-system save has no saving. If no incident record is required, measure the simpler lookup-and-action workflow separately.
unknowns: Frequency of required records and actual policy search effort
research_questions: Does the existing incident form already prefill pupil identity and current policy references?

already_counted.description: Read the applicable rule and capture and check actual incident facts

incremental.description: Maintain current policy index and incident fields

approvals.approved_version: Final incident record checked in s3; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured recordable-incident scenario; limited lookup and form-entry gains after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and administer assessments and evaluate pupil work

steps.what: Set learning objectives, practical assessment criteria and the assessment brief using actual taught material
Draft assessment questions and instructions from the supplied brief and taught material
outputs: Draft questions, instructions and proposed closed-item key

loop.purpose: Draft clear questions aligned with the supplied teaching objectives
loop.input: Teacher brief and actual taught material
loop.output: Draft questions, instructions and candidate closed-item key
loop.check: Teacher checks every question, answer and practical instruction against taught content and pupil needs in s3
loop.stop: Missing material, ambiguous answer or unsafe practical instruction returns to teacher; no release
loop.why_not_simpler: Question wording requires meaning and pedagogical fit; existing approved reusable questions are used first

steps.what: Check and correct the complete assessment, practical safety requirements, accessibility and closed-item key in its final LMS form
outputs: Final checked assessment and exact closed-item key

steps.what: Release the final assessment to the intended pupil group in the LMS
inputs: Final checked assessment and recipient group

steps.what: Administer the assessment, supervise practical work and collect actual pupil responses and work
outputs: Pupil-entered digital closed responses and actual open or practical work

steps.what: Apply the exact checked key to digitally captured closed-item responses in the LMS
inputs: Pupil-entered digital closed responses from s5
outputs: Closed-item score proposals and unmatched-response exceptions

steps.what: Assess each open answer and practical performance against the criteria using actual pupil work and observed performance
inputs: Actual pupil work and observations from s5

steps.what: Check closed-item scores and exceptions against responses, combine results and write and check individual feedback and final grades
inputs: Closed score proposals and actual responses
outputs: Final checked grades and feedback for the intended pupils

steps.what: Release the final checked grades and feedback to the intended pupils in the LMS
inputs: Final checked grades, feedback and recipients

tasks.design: Use the native quiz and gradebook functions in {LMS}, with a bounded draft helper for questions based on actual teacher material. Closed-item matching has its own deterministic step; the teacher retains practical assessment, open-answer grading and final checks before each release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing assessment wording and manually applying a fixed answer key can consume preparation and marking effort.
tasks.enabler_now: LMS keyed scoring and a draft model can assist bounded parts of assessment while retaining the teacher's criteria and checks.
tasks.still_hard: Valid assessment design, practical safety, accessibility and fair interpretation of pupils' work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher observes actual performance and understands when a score fails to reflect competence.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation and fixed-key marking effort while keeping practical and open assessment with the teacher.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; school approves material access and assessment-data handling before use

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: LMS tools can apply exact answer keys, and bounded language-model drafting can propose questions for teacher review.

assumptions: This mixed assessment includes digital closed responses entered by pupils in s5 plus open and practical work assessed by the teacher; no free transcription or practical sensor feed is assumed.
The teacher supplies objectives, criteria and taught material in s1. All generated content is checked in s3; all closed results and exceptions are checked in s8.
The s6 gain applies only where fixed-key marking is currently manual. Existing automatic scoring earns no additional saving; paper responses retain capture effort.
No separate pupil-registry re-entry is established for this task; if required, map, stage, check and gate that import as a separate step before estimating its gain.
Illustrative gross saving 16 per 100 task hours, new upkeep 3, net 13; no release-click or existing runtime saving. Deduplicate the same result entry across related tasks.
unknowns: Actual mix of closed, open and practical work and existing LMS automatic scoring
research_questions: Which current assessments still have manually keyed marking despite digitally captured responses?

already_counted.description: Create the brief, review drafted questions, check the complete assessment and check final results and feedback

incremental.description: Maintain checked question templates and key mappings and review marking discrepancies

approvals.approved_version: Final assessment and pupil group checked in s3; edits require rechecking
Final grades, feedback and pupil recipients checked in s8; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured mixed-assessment scenario with currently manual fixed-key marking; net of ongoing maintenance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer on pupil problems and agree support

steps.what: Find and check relevant existing pupil progress and support records in the school's pupil system
inputs: Existing teacher and support-team pupil records
outputs: Checked case facts and missing information

steps.what: Confer with the family and relevant school colleagues, resolve competing accounts and agree feasible support and responsibilities
outputs: Agreed support actions, responsibilities and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check the actual agreed support plan in the existing pupil-linked case form
inputs: Actual agreed support actions and responsibilities

steps.what: Save the final agreed case plan in the same pupil system

tasks.design: Configure a permission-filtered case view and pupil-linked support-plan form in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The teacher and participants resolve the problem together, and the teacher captures and checks their actual agreement before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant case records and support-plan fields may be spread across screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record views and linked forms can remove repeated navigation and identity entry.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding causes, resolving disagreements and arranging support that people can actually provide.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher can build trust and negotiate realistic action with the family and colleagues.

ambition.what: Improve access to existing case facts and required support-plan recording.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; school case-record owner verifies participant access and sensitive-field restrictions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pupil case systems can provide permission-filtered views and linked support-plan forms.

assumptions: The school already requires a case plan for this support conference; no new report is charged after an informal chat.
Existing records are entered by teachers and support colleagues; s1 checks gaps and s3 captures new agreements manually.
This proposal performs no automatic diagnosis, resource allocation or message sending. Any later communication requires its own checked final version and send step.
Illustrative gross saving 10.8 per 100 task hours, upkeep 2, net 8.8. Same-system saving earns no gain.
If this is the same conference and record as task 6625, count the shared lookup, discussion and record once rather than adding both estimates.
unknowns: Actual case-record structure and overlap with parent progress meetings
research_questions: Can existing case permissions expose the relevant progress facts without showing unrelated sensitive information?

already_counted.description: Check case sources and capture and check the actual support agreement

incremental.description: Maintain case-view fields, form and access configuration

approvals.approved_version: Final case plan checked in s3; any edit requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured support-conference scenario; reduced retrieval and required form entry after upkeep, with overlap counted once.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Use existing school record and LMS capabilities before adding a separate tool.
skills_to_grow: Design valid mixed practical and written assessments
Check exact-key scoring and manage exceptions
Handle sensitive case information with appropriate access
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who spends less time locating records and applying fixed keys while retaining actual teaching, practical observation, family discussion and support decisions.
